basic_info.description: First time on the market, ready to make your own! Set in a super prime Bernal location north of Cortland Ave and close to Bernal Heights Park, this mid-century charmer is in well-kept, original condition and awaits your personal style. Inside the foyer, note the original hardwood floors and direct access to the attached 2-car garage with great expansion potential. Upper level presents a bright living-dining area leading to the kitchen with GE electric range, Maytag oven, KitchenAid dishwasher, and a cute eat-in nook. Sliding glass doors pour with natural light, opening to a west-facing deck that's perfect for outdoor living with views of Mt. Davidson. Both bedrooms are well-sized with good closet space. The full bathroom is accessible from the rear bedroom or hallway. The lower level offers additional storage, a half bath and space with expansion potential that could be repurposed into another living area, bed/bath suite, gym, office, you name it! (Buyer to investigate possibilities.) In the backyard, a flat garden and paved patio provide another area for outdoor hangouts. A 'Walker's Paradise' per WalkScore.com, this location also provides easy access to 101, 280, tech shuttles and transit. Location, layout, and pride of ownership; all that's missing is your personal touch!
